entries.original: **Claude Sonnet 5.5** is available on Anthropic, Claude subscriptions, Bedrock, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Venice and OpenCode, with a tuned prompt preset picked automatically.
entries.translated: **Claude Sonnet 5.5** is available on Anthropic, Claude subscriptions, Bedrock, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Venice and OpenCode, with a tuned prompt preset picked automatically.

entries.original: **New category defaults:** `unspecified-low` now opens on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (medium), and `deep-low` opens on GPT-5.6 Sol (medium) with the Fast tier as its fallback. Categories you pinned yourself are unchanged. ([#9144](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9144))
entries.translated: **New category defaults:** `unspecified-low` now opens on Claude Sonnet 5.5 (medium), and `deep-low` opens on GPT-5.6 Sol (medium) with the Fast tier as its fallback. Categories you pinned yourself are unchanged. ([#9144](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9144))

entries.original: **Together AI** now defaults to Kimi K3.
entries.translated: **Together AI** now defaults to Kimi K3.

entries.original: **Built-in categories and agents stay on their own providers.** When none of a chain's listed providers was connected, OmO fell through to any provider selling a model with the same name, so a gateway such as OpenRouter could be billed for built-in categories, agents or `model_profile` lanes you never configured. They now run only on the providers their chain lists, and a gateway is used only when you pin it yourself. ([#9146](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9146))
entries.translated: **Built-in categories and agents stay on their own providers.** When none of a chain's listed providers was connected, OmO fell through to any provider selling a model with the same name, so a gateway such as OpenRouter could be billed for built-in categories, agents or `model_profile` lanes you never configured. They now run only on the providers their chain lists, and a gateway is used only when you pin it yourself. ([#9146](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9146))

entries.original: When only a gateway serves a built-in category, the task notice and `omo doctor` show the exact opt-in line, for example `categories.writing.model = "openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-5.5"`.
entries.translated: When only a gateway serves a built-in category, the task notice and `omo doctor` show the exact opt-in line, for example `categories.writing.model = "openrouter/anthropic/claude-opus-5.5"`.

entries.original: **One task host per session.** Background tasks used to share one machine-wide host, so a crash, out-of-memory kill or wedge in that host stopped every session's tasks at once. Each session's tasks now run on that session's own host, so a failure stays inside the session that caused it. ([#9003](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9003))
entries.translated: **One task host per session.** Background tasks used to share one machine-wide host, so a crash, out-of-memory kill or wedge in that host stopped every session's tasks at once. Each session's tasks now run on that session's own host, so a failure stays inside the session that caused it. ([#9003](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9003))

entries.original: Long sessions no longer die when a restart has to resend a history that is too large: OmO compacts once and retries instead of failing every following turn with "Prompt is too long". ([#7975](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7975))
entries.translated: Long sessions no longer die when a restart has to resend a history that is too large: OmO compacts once and retries instead of failing every following turn with "Prompt is too long". ([#7975](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7975))

entries.original: Changing the thinking level while a turn is running no longer ends that turn, and a failed request no longer forces a resend of the whole history. ([#8759](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8759))
entries.translated: Changing the thinking level while a turn is running no longer ends that turn, and a failed request no longer forces a resend of the whole history. ([#8759](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8759))

entries.original: Claude subscription sessions stop resending their full history over and over, and recovering from a checkpoint is safe again. ([#8424](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8424))
entries.translated: Claude subscription sessions stop resending their full history over and over, and recovering from a checkpoint is safe again. ([#8424](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/8424))

entries.original: Claude subscription requests identify as the current Claude Code version.
entries.translated: Claude subscription requests identify as the current Claude Code version.

entries.original: AWS credentials in your environment no longer make Bedrock the default model when you have logged in to another provider. AWS-only setups still start on Bedrock, and a default you saved always wins.
entries.translated: AWS credentials in your environment no longer make Bedrock the default model when you have logged in to another provider. AWS-only setups still start on Bedrock, and a default you saved always wins.

entries.original: A model you set for a LazyCodex agent (for example `explorer` or `librarian`) now survives updates instead of being reset. ([#5245](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/5245))
entries.translated: A model you set for a LazyCodex agent (for example `explorer` or `librarian`) now survives updates instead of being reset. ([#5245](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/5245))

entries.original: The macOS binaries now carry valid signatures; the Intel (x64) binary previously shipped with a broken one.
entries.translated: The macOS binaries now carry valid signatures; the Intel (x64) binary previously shipped with a broken one.
